findings.title: Payment.create called with wrong argument order
findings.body: The new `idempotency_key` parameter is passed as the third argument to `Payment.create`, but the signature of `Payment.create` is not shown. If the signature expects `order_id`, `amount_cents`, `idempotency_key`, this call will misalign the values. Verify the parameter order and update the call accordingly.

summary.problem: The idempotency key feature introduces a potential correctness issue due to an unvalidated call to `Payment.create`.
summary.done_well: The change adds idempotency key handling and checks for existing payments, improving safety against duplicate processing.
